straight_edge_feasibility_witness_only.meaning: Illustration of possible tilted edges; not selected panel dimensions or full prism certificate.

findings.text: Selected axial placements leave 54.4 mm to HCAL and ECT warm case; B1/inner, B2/middle and B3/outer nominal axial seams are 50 mm. Outer wheel clears rear carrier by100 mm and world by250 mm. These are nominal prototype margins, not installation tolerances.

Whole inner trapezoids must use tilted straight edges/corridors certified against the BT legs. A30-degree full radial wedge with20 mm seams collides; a constant0.70 m parallel corridor is incompatible with a positive base at the0.70 m bore. The arithmetic witness shows a tilted-edge option exists but is not a complete module certificate.

A continuous B3 extension intersects BT rounded returns: R8.2,z11.7,phi0 lies only15.1 mm from the source centreline, inside the250 mm warm reservation. Repack/revalidate every accepted finite prism and retain resulting gaps; do not reuse an old certificate without rerunning its domain.

Lengthening48front lugs from0.10 to0.60 m adds1.44 m3 gross Al proxy or3888 kg before union. Inner5.8 m ports clear the inner wheel radially by at least250 mm, but the6.8 m ports overlap the B2 radial shell. Existing B2 modules require new full-volume clearance checks. Update endpoints/contact graph, not just stock lengths.

ECT geometry changes require a fresh full self/mutual energy matrix. Current-only rescaling of the old matrix is invalid for shortening. Retain selected NI explicitly and avoid unconditionally calling normalize_currents. Recompute joint field/cold allocation and check cold lies within warm; old response target labels are superseded.

Use the same new closed entrance/world and extended map domain for both layouts. Record that the physical before/after combines geometry and field changes; retain full4pi and frozen endcap denominators and field failures. The new numerical map and common launch stencil validity still require implementation checks.
